fields.title: Spotify URI match record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one match result per input line. MATCH rows carry either the matched track or the rejected best guess; ERROR rows cover lines that could not be searched at all. Spotify adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The line that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: pathfinder-searchSuggestions, input-passthrough when the line was already a Spotify reference, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: empty_query or search_failed.

inputLine.title: Input line
inputLine.description: The original text, unchanged, so the output can be joined back to the source list.

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: True when the best candidate cleared the minimum score.

matchConfidence.title: Confidence
matchConfidence.description: exact, high, medium or low. A title-only query is capped at high however well it scores, because several recordings share a title and nothing corroborates which one is meant.

matchScore.title: Match score
matchScore.description: 0 to 1. A weighted blend of title and artist similarity, adjusted by duration when one was supplied.

titleScore.title: Title score
titleScore.description: How closely the candidate's title matched, ignoring featured-artist and version suffixes.

artistScore.title: Artist score
artistScore.description: How closely the candidate's artist matched. 0 when no artist was supplied and none appeared in the line.

durationDeltaMs.title: Duration difference
durationDeltaMs.description: Milliseconds between the supplied duration and the candidate's, when a duration was given.

queryTitle.title: Interpreted title
queryTitle.description: Which part of the line was read as the title. Both orders are tried and the better-scoring reading is the one reported here.

queryArtist.title: Interpreted artist
queryArtist.description: Which part of the line was read as the artist.

candidatesConsidered.title: Candidates considered
candidatesConsidered.description: How many track candidates Spotify returned for this line.

trackName.title: Track name
trackName.description: Matched rows: the song title as Spotify has it, version suffixes included.

albumName.title: Album
albumName.description: Matched rows: the release the recording sits on.

albumUrl.title: Album URL
albumUrl.description: Matched rows: open.spotify.com link to the album.

trackUri.title: Track URI
trackUri.description: Matched rows: the spotify:track: URI - the form Spotify's own import tools and API accept.

trackUrl.title: Track URL
trackUrl.description: Matched rows: open.spotify.com link to the track.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Matched rows: track length as m:ss.

durationMs.title: Duration (ms)
durationMs.description: Matched rows: track length in milliseconds.

explicit.title: Explicit
explicit.description: Matched rows: true when Spotify labels the recording explicit.

unmatchedReason.title: Why unmatched
unmatchedReason.description: Unmatched rows: what the best candidate was and the score it fell short by.

bestGuessName.title: Best guess
bestGuessName.description: Unmatched rows: the closest candidate's title, for manual review.

bestGuessArtist.title: Best guess artist
bestGuessArtist.description: Unmatched rows: the closest candidate's artist.

bestGuessUri.title: Best guess URI
bestGuessUri.description: Unmatched rows: the closest candidate's URI, so an accepted guess can be used without re-running.

bestGuessUrl.title: Best guess URL
bestGuessUrl.description: Unmatched rows: open.spotify.com link to the closest candidate.

note.title: Note
note.description: Present when the line was already a Spotify reference and no search was performed.
